name: Kathy Hochul
stance: Signed and is implementing the RAISE Act frontier-model safety law and says states must act while the federal government does not.

statements.text: By enacting the RAISE Act, New York is once again leading the nation in setting a strong and sensible standard for frontier AI safety, holding the biggest developers accountable for their safety and transparency protocols.
statements.outlet: Office of the Governor of New York

statements.text: Signed the RAISE Act chapter amendment (S8828), aligning it with California's SB 53 thresholds and setting a January 1, 2027 effective date.
Donald Trump and Washington Republicans may be standing still as AI grows more unpredictable, but New York will not.
statements.outlet: Office of the Governor of New York

statements.text: Announced RAISE Act implementation: large frontier developers must register with the state in November 2026, and named Marc Gilman to lead the new DIGIT office at the Department of Financial Services.
statements.outlet: Office of the Governor of New York
